description: CMOS transmission-gate adiabatic, dual-rail series-parallel pull networks, 4-phase power clock -- with the campaign's series_limit=6 convention
note: THE SHIPPED DEFAULT and the target every published number uses. Identical to tgate except series_limit, which is 6 rather than the mapper's built-in 4. Every harness used to clone the tgate record and override this field at runtime, under the name 'tgate_sl6'; the C mapper had no way to learn it and silently kept 4, which is how the two implementations came to build different circuits for the same nominal target. It lives in a file now so both read it. The mapper family is 'tgate'; this file supplies the parameter overrides.

provenance.c_dev_ff: Nangate45 typical library characterised input capacitance (INV_X1 A pin = 1.70 fF); a CMOS transmission gate presents an NMOS+PMOS gate pair, taken as 1.70 fF total.
provenance.v: 1.1 V, matching the Liberty file used elsewhere.
provenance.status: CALIBRATED CONSTANTS WITH STATED PROVENANCE, not SPICE extractions. See APPROXIMATIONS A15.
provenance.series_limit: 6 -- the campaign convention (item 29 will replace it with a process-justified interval). Load-bearing: at least one adopted optimization arm inverts under a different cap.
